kind: default-on screen, title rows on one binary: ON (no switch env, the shipped default) on Halo and eight titles chosen by where the switches act, Halo with IBC off (HNI) and with all four off (HOFF)
queue_order: pilot HON, HNI (Halo jumps the Nova queue until 07:30 PDT); judged; then HOFF, MKSM, TS, RS, SHR, CLR, AMP. One run each: [TITLE_ROUTES=<routes_dir>] request.sh --who defaulton1017 --device nova --title <title> [--route <route>] --seconds <s> --ref ed2b1d3333 --perflog [--pull 'frametrace_*'] --env <each> --issue 1018 --expect docs/testing/predictions/defaulton1017-screen.json --purpose 'defaulton1017 row <ROW>'. a_env is HOFF's list, b_env HON's.
judge: python3 docs/lanes/defaulton1017/screenread.py --row HON=<id> --row HNI=<id> ... --expect docs/testing/predictions/defaulton1017-screen.json (Halo span via halo1016's vcpuread/earlyread readers); MKSM: python3 docs/lanes/fps1015/s2tread.py <MKSM> 1792163893-fps1015-717142 (fps1015's off1); TS: python3 docs/lanes/fps1015/tsread.py <TS> 0-1792170186-fps1015-2314810 (fps1015's off1). Route shots are looked at, not scored.
baseline: halo1016-early.json arm EIF (0-0-x-1792231796-halo1016-2209151, 08fd920b5c, the three on by env, IBC=1): 33.8 ms/f over [mark+131, mark+191], every 10 s window 33.4-34.7; E (no chain, no IBC) 35.9; all off (S2T_CVT unset) 59.3. fps1015 on runs: MKSM 54.2-54.4 fps over 1800 frames, Top Spin 59 fps in match play.
prediction: #1018 default-on screen. The four switches now read unset as on. HG: HON holds Halo's span at EIF's level, mean <= 34.5 ms/f and every 10 s window <= 35.5, P 0.75 (the only differences from EIF are the gap-1 gate and the answer ring). HEA: HON answers >= 0.98 of the span's armed reports early (Halo re-queues each offset one guest frame later), P 0.8. HVIS: HON's vis <= 0.02 of its early answers, P 0.6. HDS: desync <= 0.001 of early in every ON row with early > 0, P 0.9. HIBC: HNI's span mean >= HON's + 0.5 ms/f (IBC is needed for the bar; additive estimate from the vCPU arms: EF ~35.1), P 0.65; if it fails, IBC goes back to off by default. HOFF: the four log off and HOFF's span mean >= 52 ms/f, P 0.85. MKF: MKSM >= 52 fps over s2tread's span and its route V, P 0.85; MKE: MKSM early = 0 (no visibility tests in the census), P 0.8. TSF: Top Spin match >= 56 fps and tsread's V, P 0.8. RV, SV, CV, AV: RS, SHR, CLR, AMP each end valid (pace lines to the end, no crash), P 0.85 each; in each with early >= 1000, vis <= 0.02 of early, P 0.6. FL: flips = 0 in every ON row that logs a [fldcw1018] n= line, P 0.5 (Halo 0; elsewhere unknown).
expect_note: EMPTY of captures ON PURPOSE: a soak writes none. Named rules read by docs/lanes/defaulton1017/screenread.py --expect. V per row: ON rows log `[s2tcvt] on HAKUX_S2T_CVT=(unset)` where the check is reached, `[rearly1018] early=1 ... HAKUX_REPORT_EARLY=(unset)`, `[fldcw1018] chain=1 HAKUX_FLDCW_CHAIN=(unset)`, `[ibc507] on=1 layout=ok ... HAKUX_IBC=(unset)`; HNI the same but `[ibc507] on=0`; HOFF `[s2tcvt] off`, `early=0`, `chain=0`, `on=0`. Halo rows also `mark cinematic` and >= 20 `[rtrace] w` windows, mode=async. A V failure voids that row's legs. Early share = early / (early + cold + skip0 + skipn + full) over the row's [rearly1018] w windows (Halo: the windows inside the span). vis and desync are shares of early over the same windows.
